sv.title: Donald Trumps ord om FBI-hackningen: Positivt
sv.summary: FBI hackades återigen i veckan. Donald Trump reagerar märkligt positivt. – Vi kanske får veta saker vi inte hade fått reda på annars, säger han.

en.title: Donald Trump's words on the FBI hack: Positive
en.summary: The FBI was hacked again this week. Donald Trump reacts strangely positively. – We may get to know things we would not have found out otherwise, he says.
